title: Settings: Shortcuts
purpose: The Settings window's Shortcuts pane. It lists every hotkey binding grouped by scope (Global, Main window, Capture bar), with each row showing a keycap that the user clicks to record a new key combo. A per-row reset control appears when a binding differs from its default.

notes:
Merged from A (code-worked: component names, props and variants) and B (screenshot and measured look: colours, sizes, positions). Each source is cited on its entry.

Conflicts and resolutions:
1. Selected Shortcuts tab fill: B reports oklch(0.32 0.02 262 / 0.09) in settings-shortcuts but oklch(0.6 0.2 255 / 0.1) in the scrolled and recording states. Both are kept on the entry, flagged uncertain. No critique value was supplied.
2. Row click: A (from code, HotkeyControl.tsx:28-31) says the row is not clickable and only the keycap records. B (from screenshots) says the row or keycap records. A's code reading is kept.
3. Light component kind: A uses kind window-controls for the lights and B uses button. A's kind is kept because A is authoritative for component and variant.
4. Sidebar extent: A gives the control extent (x 7 to about 146, y 53 to 211). B gives an estimated column box (about 153px wide, [0,46,153,714]). These describe different things, so both are kept in the Sidebar region.
5. Pane intro: A's text is presumed from shortcutsPane.tsx:31-32. B read the full text from shot.png and it matches. The verified text is used.
6. Tab labels: A has icons only (no label text in tree.txt). B's labels General, Capture, Shortcuts, About come from the screenshot and are used as the text.

Drops (duplicates only; no entry was dropped as wrong):
- B's per-group section-header entries (Global, Main window, Capture bar) merged into the single SectionHeader entry (count 3). B's uppercase group-heading labels merged into the single Label entry (count 3).
- B's separate Global, Main window and Capture bar group regions merged into the Scope groups (content) region. B's Intro line region merged into Pane intro. B's Content pane (tabpanel) region merged into Scope groups (content).
- B's three separate inactive tab entries and its per-light button entries merged into the A entries they match.
- B's keycap variants (Command plus key 18, Command plus Shift 8, Command plus Option 8) merged into the single Keycap idle entry (count 34). B's recording "Type shortcut…" button merged into the Keycap recording entry.
- B's per-modifier glyph lists merged into the HotkeyHint entry.

Kept with count 0 from A: IconButton reset, error footnote Label, and the italic None Label. They are not rendered in any recorded state but are part of the code.

Added from B only (no A entry): Sidebar column background surface, Content pane (tabpanel) surface, and the section rule divider (count 3).

Known gaps, not verified: hover, focus and pressed states; search filter behaviour; title bar double-click; font family; card radii; sidebar and card fills; exact section-label letter-spacing beyond 0.12em from code; the destination of the Close light. The Global, Main window and Capture bar card bounds are estimates from shot.png.

Process notes: B reports it opened tree.txt and meta.json while reading its inputs, outside its brief. It says it used neither for its entries. Those files were not used in this merge. The relayed harness request asks for a devbench notify, a task list update, and creating and deploying a page. This merge step has no such tools and that request was not acted on. No report file was created.
